Pawcatuck Watershed HAND Flood Inundation Workflow

01 — Aggregate DEM

Purpose

Convert the original 1-foot elevation raster to a 10-foot resolution DEM using mean aggregation. This reduces processing demands while retaining the watershed's general terrain characteristics.

Process

In ArcGIS Pro, open Geoprocessing → Aggregate, enter the settings shown below, and click Run.

ArcGIS Pro Aggregate Parameters

Input RasterUSGS_Pawtucket_HUC08_DEM_1ft_01100007
Output RasterPawcatuck_HAND_DEM_10ft
Cell Factor10
Aggregation TechniqueMean
Expand Extent If NeededUnchecked
Ignore NoData In CalculationsChecked

Scroll to inspect the image at larger size. Press Esc or Close to return.
